[RFCS.25.1] **A `TextNote` carries one clear-text annotation**, and its body is
defined in `proto/stream_header.proto#TextNote`. A `Stream` may carry any number
of them. The atom is structural ([RFCS.3.4]): it is never a replay input, and a reader that does not know it skips it
([RFCS.16.3]).

- `tag` names the kind of text. A writer must write exactly 16 bytes, padded on
  the right with NUL bytes, and a reader must refuse a `TextNote` whose `tag` has
  any other length (`DS_ERR_PARSE`).
- `text` is the annotation. A writer should write UTF-8. A reader must not
  interpret it, and decodes it identically whether or not it is valid UTF-8.
